出生地: 美国,路易斯安那州,新奥尔良
简介: Weller was born in New Orleans and is a cousin of actor Peter Weller. He is a graduate of Jesuit High School, a Catholic all-boys high school in New Orleans, and the University of North Carolina. He married Ali Marsh on September 6, 2003. Mary McCormack is the godmother to Weller's daughter.
